title: ONP: Prioritized contextual anomaly notifications for usage/cost/latency
creator: Aisha Nambiar
description:
Goal: Reduce noise and improve triage time by delivering prioritized, deduplicated anomaly notifications enriched with contextual signals for usage, cost, and latency. This ticket adds an Onboarding Notification Prioritizer (ONP) layer into the existing telemetry pipeline that performs: 1) enrichment (customer metadata, recent deploys, known incidents), 2) deduplication across correlated metrics, 3) priority scoring (impact estimate + severity + confidence), and 4) suppression/aggregation policies tuned per-organization.

Why now: We see high alert fatigue in SRE/CSM handoffs when spike events hit usage and cost dashboards. Current alerts are metric-centric and produce many simultaneous notifications for the same underlying event (e.g., autoscaling misconfiguration -> cost spike + latency increase). ONP will reduce duplicate noise, route high-impact issues first, and include contextual links to dashboards/PRs/runbooks to speed MTTR.

Scope: backend-only work to implement enrichment, scoring, and notification routing; integration points with notification bus and Console UI flags are included. UI for configuring suppression windows and priority thresholds is tracked in a sibling PM ticket.

Non-goals: full ML-based root-cause identification, incident automation (playbook execution) - those come later as follow-ups.
acceptance_criteria: Notifications for correlated metric bursts must be deduplicated into a single ticket with a computed priority label (P0/P1/P2).
Priority score is calculated using impact_estimate, severity, and confidence and stored on the alert event.
On average, system reduces duplicate notifications by >=45% for synthetic correlated events injected in staging.
Enrichment attaches: customer tier, most recent deploy id, top-3 correlated metrics, link to per-tenant usage dashboard, and link to suspected recent GitHub PR when available.
Runtime instrumentation exposed: alert backlog gauge, ONP processing latency summary, and per-tenant suppression rate; dashboards created in Console Observability space.
Canary rollout plan executed: 10% orgs for 48 hours, monitor false suppression, then 100%.
Runbook and 'how to interpret ONP priority' doc published and linked from alerts.
tasks: Design enrichment schema and protobuf change for telemetry events
Extend ingestion pipeline to attach tenant and deploy metadata (ETL job + cache lookup)
Implement correlation windowing and simple clustering (time-series window join rules)
Build priority scoring function (rule-based initial implementation) and expose score on event
Add suppression/aggregation rules with configurable tenant overrides
Integrate ONP output with notification bus and routing service
Create observability dashboards and SLOs for ONP processing latency
Write integration tests and staged canary plan; document runbook
